title: The Lentil Soup — Recorded Instructions
gist_ar: تعليمات مسجّلة خطوة بخطوة لعمل شوربة عدس لأربع أشخاص.

before_listening.en: A cooking programme gives instructions. Listen for the mistake the cook tells you NOT to make.
before_listening.ar: برنامج طبخ بيدي تعليمات. ركّز على الغلطة اللي بيقولك متعملهاش.

segments.speaker: Cook
segments.text: Welcome to Kitchen Minute. Today: lentil soup for four people. You need two cups of red lentils, one large onion, two carrots, a little salt, and plenty of water, about six cups. You don't need much oil; one spoon is enough. First, wash the lentils twice. Then cut the onion and the carrots into small pieces. Put a little oil in the pot and cook the onion for two minutes, until it is soft. Add the lentils, the carrots and all the water. Cook everything for twenty-five minutes. Now listen carefully: don't add too much salt at the beginning. Add it at the end and taste it. If the soup is too thick, add some hot water, never cold water. Serve it with bread and a few slices of lemon.
